teaching.name: Percentages and percentage change

default.aim: Find a percentage of an amount.

help.title: whole
help.explanation: The whole is the original amount represented by 100%.
help.guidance: Identify what the percentage is of before choosing a calculation.

help.title: Choose the calculation
help.explanation: Percent means out of 100. A percentage can be written as a fraction or a decimal multiplier.
help.guidance: For a percentage of an amount, divide the percentage by 100 and multiply by the amount.

help.title: requested amount
help.explanation: The percentage part, the new amount and the percentage change are different quantities.
help.guidance: For an increase or decrease, add or subtract the change. To find percentage change, divide the change by the original amount and multiply by 100.
examples: £50 increased by 20% rises by £10 to £60. From £50 to £60, the percentage change is 10 ÷ 50 × 100 = 20%.

amount.name: Find a percentage of an amount
amount.when: The whole amount and a percentage are known.
steps: Find one percent by dividing the whole by 100.
amount.check: Use the original amount as 100%. Apply the calculated percentage to reconstruct the amount or change.

increase.name: Find a new amount after an increase
increase.when: The amount increases by a given percentage.
steps: Find the percentage of the original amount.
Add that increase to the original amount.
increase.check: Use the original amount as 100%. Apply the calculated percentage to reconstruct the amount or change.

decrease.name: Find a new amount after a decrease
decrease.when: The amount decreases by a given percentage.
steps: Find the percentage of the original amount.
Subtract that decrease from the original amount.
decrease.check: Use the original amount as 100%. Apply the calculated percentage to reconstruct the amount or change.

percentage-increase.name: Calculate a percentage increase
percentage-increase.when: The original and larger new amount are known.
steps: Subtract original from new to find the increase.
Divide by the original amount and multiply by 100.
percentage-increase.check: Use the original amount as 100%. Apply the calculated percentage to reconstruct the amount or change.

percentage-decrease.name: Calculate a percentage decrease
percentage-decrease.when: The original and smaller new amount are known.
steps: Subtract new from original to find the decrease.
Divide by the original amount and multiply by 100.
percentage-decrease.check: Use the original amount as 100%. Apply the calculated percentage to reconstruct the amount or change.
